main_body: Thatched-roof hut: a large sloped thatch roof (rows 0-36) over a plank wall front with a door and window (rows 38-63)
top_band: Golden thatch roof slope, rows 0-34, in banded courses from light gold to mid gold, ending in a lighter eave lip at rows 34-36
evidence: Reading down the middle column, the thatch roof slope fills rows 0-34 as a large surface. A lighter eave lip at rows 34-36 marks the front edge. A dark shadow band at rows 37-39 sits under it. Below that is the plank wall front with a door with a dark frame and iron straps, an inset shuttered window, and a stone step. The structure matches the reference houses, where a big roof slope sits above a wall face. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The thatch has course bands with per-strand highlights and dark gaps, giving about 5 tones. The planks carry vertical grain and the door is detailed with straps. The outer roof silhouette uses a near-black edge, while the door and wall frames use dark brown, so the outline is mixed. There are no large flat fills. Tile density is a little below the references' tiled roof and stone wall, but it is acceptable beside them.
